positions.title: Technical Program Manager
positions.description:
Ownership of projects through design, delivery and support.

Manage intra and cross functional projects including definition, roadmap planning, resource planning and execution.

Work with business, operations leadership, and executive leadership to define product and provide project updates.

Manage all aspects of projects such as planning, requirements definition, risk management, communication, and implementation.

Work closely with the development teams and play a leadership role in product architecture and design.

Make project decisions, achieving tactical goals while retaining a strategic focus.

company.name: IGT (formerly GTECH), a subsidiary of International Game Technology PLC

positions.title: Game Software Development Production Manager
positions.description:
Supervise day-to-day department operating processes and increase efficiency of team while maintaining a high level of quality standards.

Manage a team of technicians responsible for the production of variable data for scratch-off lottery tickets.

Define assignments and provide guidance to technicians.

Prioritize and plan work and track progress to meet tight production schedule.

Maintain and improve communication with internal departments, external auditors and customers.

Report progress to internal customers and management and provide input to the overall production 

planning process.

Provide training to employees with the goal of improving technical skills and efficiencies.

Analyze and identify all performance related issues and ensure appropriate steps to prevent loss of quality and delivery delays.

Lead, motivate, coach, and mentor staff as needed.

Ensure adherence to departmental policies, procedures and standards.

Oversee projects and prepare updates within required timeframe and delegate assignments as necessary.

Provide staff with career development, counseling, and performance management.

Continually analyze processes and recommend improvements to reduce costs or increase efficiency.

positions.title: Programming Team Lead
positions.description:
Software Developers Team Lead.

Oversee the integration of new clients to the company. 

Analyze client validation systems, software, and layout parameters to utilize algorithms for the encryption of ticket data. 

Developed and implemented encryption algorithms that are vital to the printing and delivery of secure tickets to the customer.

Programmed printed games (tickets) reports to provide customer for statistical values on final printed product.

Designed and coded an automated auditing tool for printed tickets reports. This tool increased productivity and reliability resulting in saved time and money. Improved accuracy 100% (C#, VB.NET).

Coded data printed under the scratch off area of a lottery ticket for several types of games to include bingo, crosswords, blackjack, poker, tic-tac, etc. (C++/ATL).

Developed upgrades of legacy tools to newer technology to provide increased productivity, accuracy, and end-user reporting. 

Developed a simple method of validating tickets for clients with limited internet capabilities.

Developed SharePoint Knowledge Base used to disseminate information throughout software department.

Developed Issue Tracking and Metrics System to pinpoint common sources of errors and create corrective action plans.

Delegate tasks based on production priorities.

Trained Software engineers at the Junior Level.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Develop data verification software.

Analyze client validation systems, software, and layout parameters to utilize algorithms for the encryption of ticket data. 

Developed and implemented encryption algorithms that are vital to the printing and delivery of secure tickets to the customer.

Programmed printed games (tickets) reports to provide customer for statistical values on final printed product.

Trained Software engineers at the Junior Level.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop, maintain, and troubleshot the Medical Practice and Electronic Medical Records program

Provide tier 2 and 3 technical support

Work directly with multiple doctor’s offices to resolve issues

Champion “LabLink,” a laboratory results delivery system that automatically ordered and imported the results of laboratory tests into the patients file over the internet

Implement the HL7 transmission protocol complying with government and HIPA regulations

Lead programming meetings, software testing, participated in sales calls, and installation of the system between both the laboratory company and the doctor’s office

Responsible for training other developers in the use of and implementation of the system

Assign developers to a doctor’s office for the maintenance of the link
